title: The BlockStrap Page Builder – Bootstrap Blocks plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via…
description: The BlockStrap Page Builder – Bootstrap Blocks plugin for WordPress up to version 0.1.65 is vulnerable to stored cross-site scripting (XSS) via the 'comment' parameter. This vulnerability arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping, allowing unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts that execute when users view the affected pages. Exploitation requires that the attacker previously had at least one comment approved with a specific name and email, enabling subsequent comments to bypass moderation under WordPress's default policy. Additionally, exploitation is limited to sites using a block theme, which is the WordPress default.
